To reproduce the issue, call fetchUserProfile(id:) with an empty string. The function throws ValidationError, which is logged by the DiagnosticRecorder. You can reproduce it locally with:

```swift
let result = try client.fetchUserProfile(id: "")
```

The fix will ship in the next patch release.
